issue: The tenant's front door only shuts if it is slammed. An engineer visiting for another job warned the tenant that the door glass will shatter if this continues.
why_urgent: This is the main exit. Slamming risks the glass shattering and injuring someone, and the door may not secure the property.
risk_if_delayed: Injury from broken glass, and an insecure property overnight.
facts_uncertain: No contractor has inspected the door yet, and we have not confirmed whether the glass is already cracked.
options: Option 1: we send an emergency door and glazing contractor today to make it safe, estimated one hundred and fifty to three hundred pounds. Option 2: you use your own contractor, who must attend within 24 hours. Option 3: we apply temporary safety film or boarding today and book the full repair for later.
recommendation_reason: it removes the injury risk today and the cost is in line with a normal emergency call-out
